data.title: 三司绫濑 · 留在花束里的字条
data.description: 绫濑在后台读到你放进花束的字条，先把纸折好，才忍不住笑了一声。她把字条收进口袋，准备出去找你。
data.action: holding a small note beside a bouquet
data.promptProse: In a dimly lit backstage dressing room, Ayase leans over a vanity table strewn with performance makeup and brushes, gently reading a small, handwritten note nestled within a large, vibrant bouquet. The warm vanity bulbs create a soft, inviting halo around her, reflecting in the mirror and highlighting the quiet joy on her face as she tenderly folds the paper.
data.animaCaption: The note came from her partner and rests in her hands.
